speculation_cost.note: Draft counter includes prompt-context updates, so attributing ~27 seconds to target decode and ~4 seconds to drafting is approximate. Verification is not free; two accepted tokens/verification do not imply 2x wall-clock gain.

full_block_experiment.conclusion: No acceptance gain on this prompt; higher draft cost. Default unchanged.

next_recommended_step: Prototype a T-MAC-style kernel on actual Glimmer matrices at 1/3/4/8 rows, compare with current kernels and modern llama.cpp; measure full-model speed only after math/storage checks. Separately evaluate activation sparsity if quality tradeoffs are accepted. Do not promise another 10x on unchanged Glimmer.
